services.title: Civil and Structural Design
services.short: Design and certification of industrial, refinery, commercial, residential and infrastructure structures.
services.overview: We design the load-carrying frame of a building or industrial structure and certify it, so owners, contractors and authorities can build with confidence. Work covers structures in structural steel and in reinforced concrete.
involves: Assessing loads and selecting a suitable structural system
Analysis and design to applicable Indian and international codes
Design calculations and certification
Handing over to detailing so the design becomes buildable drawings

services.title: Structural Steel Design
services.short: Steel frames, sheds, platforms and towers — the core of more than 865 projects stated in our profile.
services.overview: Structural steel is light, fast to erect and ideal for large spans and heavy industrial duty. We design steel members and their connections so the structure is safe, economical and practical to fabricate.
involves: Framing layout and member sizing
Connection design (including joint design tools such as IDEA StatiCa)
Platforms, supports and bracing for equipment
Coordination with 3D modelling and fabrication drawings

services.title: Reinforced Concrete (RCC) Design
services.short: Design of reinforced concrete structures, including conveyor supports and liquid-storage tanks.
services.overview: Reinforced concrete combines concrete and steel bars to carry heavy, long-lasting loads. Our profile lists 115 RCC projects, including industrial conveyor supports and tanks.
involves: Structural analysis and member design
Reinforcement design and detailing support (RCDC / RCDC FE)
Liquid-retaining structure design to IS 3370
Design of underground storage tanks

services.title: 3D Modelling and Detailing
services.short: Digital 3D models for precise layout of industrial equipment and supporting structures.
services.overview: A 3D model is a digital twin of the structure. It lets everyone see how steelwork, equipment and access fit together before anything is fabricated, which reduces clashes and rework.
involves: Building accurate 3D models of structures and platforms
Laying out equipment and supports precisely
Extracting drawings and material lists from the model
Modelling with tools such as Solid Edge and Prosteel

services.title: Fabrication and Construction Drawings
services.short: Detailed, fabrication, construction and survey drawings ready for the workshop and the site.
services.overview: Drawings are how a design reaches the workshop floor and the construction site. We prepare clear, coordinated drawing sets that fabricators and contractors can follow.
involves: Detailed drawings of members and connections
Fabrication drawings for the workshop
Construction drawings for the site
Survey drawings

services.title: Finite Element Analysis (FEA)
services.short: Advanced analysis of special, complex and non-conventional structures and components.
services.overview: FEA breaks a complicated component into thousands of small elements to see how stress flows through it. It is used when standard hand methods are not enough, and is carried out as required by the client.
involves: Building an analysis model of the component or structure
Checking stress and behaviour under load
Reporting results to support design decisions
uses: Base plates (example: base plate analysis model for a project in Iran)

services.title: Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and Estimation
services.short: Exact bills of material and BOQ estimation for industrial structures.
services.overview: A bill of quantities lists what a structure needs — how much steel, concrete and other materials. It helps clients budget, tender and purchase accurately.
involves: Preparing exact bills of materials for industrial structures
BOQ and estimation
Linking quantities to the design and 3D model

services.title: Solar Structure Feasibility and Design
services.short: Feasibility, shadow analysis and structural design of solar power structures.
services.overview: Solar arrays need supporting structures that hold panels at the right position and survive wind and weather. We assess feasibility, study shadows, and design the supporting structure.
involves: Feasibility assessment
Shadow analysis
Structural design of solar power structures

services.title: Design Review and Engineering Consultation
services.short: Design review at client request and detailed calculations for third-party consultants.
services.overview: Sometimes you already have a design and want an experienced second opinion. We review designs on request and can supply detailed calculations to a third-party consultant when required.
involves: Reviewing designs and calculations at the client’s request
Providing detailed calculations to third-party consultants
Advising on practical engineering decisions
